question_results.domain: Explicit higher prism index, same exterior on both faces and ordinary direct transmitted two-face path. Apparent image direction is distinguished from physical ray deviation.
question_results.SCI_evidence: The frozen independent baseline gives base-directed physical deviation and apex-directed apparent shift for this higher-index domain. Reversing index ordering would reverse the directions and is expressly outside the displayed model.
question_results.every_visible_option: Both locales: a incorrectly copies actual base deviation to the image; b has apex image/base ray and is uniquely true; c copies the image direction to the forward ray; d reverses both physical and apparent directions.
question_results.hidden_comparison: Correct set b agrees. All four per-option truth tags and derivations agree with the sealed assessment. Wrong procedures genuinely confuse backward projection or reverse normal bending; they do not constitute alternate correct answers in the stated domain.
question_results.ZHEN_evidence: All model qualifiers, the image/ray distinction, each direction pair, hidden rationale and limitation correspond in both languages.
question_results.production_loss: Direction-pair recognition cannot establish independent ray construction, backward projection or written proof; these declared losses do not remove the central direction distinction.

question_results.domain: Original strictly totally reflected water ray in transparent homogeneous plane-parallel water/oil/air layers, geometrical optics, no edge/roughness/scattering rescue.
question_results.SCI_evidence: K=N_water sin(alpha)>N_air remains invariant at parallel interfaces. Oil may admit no segment, a grazing segment or a transmitted segment according to N_oil versus K; none permits propagating escape into air. The original critical equality, if considered as a boundary limit rather than strict TIR, is grazing, not nonzero normal escape.
question_results.every_visible_option: Both locales: a ignores the new final interface; b treats a small oil angle as escape without its critical-angle change; c uniquely gives no escape independent of the oil index; d mistakes an index needed for an intermediate angle for one needed for the final verdict.
question_results.hidden_comparison: Correct set c agrees. All four truth tags and rationales use the same conserved quantity and distinguish entering oil from ultimately entering air. No invented numerical oil index, thickness or bookRaw answer appears.
question_results.ZHEN_evidence: Same ray, parallel planes, excluded scattering mechanisms, four index-dependence claims and all hidden explanations are equivalent.
question_results.production_loss: Recognition does not establish written invariant proof or complete first-interface case analysis; the final-air judgment and meaningful index misconception are retained.

question_results.domain: Positive absolute n and positive symbolic external n_a, equilateral finite faces, equal vertex distances and nongrazing entry/exit; current visible text does not exclude internal reflection.
question_results.SCI_evidence: The already sealed reflected-route counterexample has equal vertex distances and normal entry/exit for arbitrarily large n/n_a>2. Thus none of the four finite range/supremum options describes the entire literal route domain.
question_results.every_visible_option: Both locales: a is only conditionally true for a direct chord; b incorrectly includes grazing equality as a maximum even there; c substitutes an absolute2 for relative2 despite arbitrary n_a; d uses a45-degree rather than30-degree internal-angle coefficient. All four are false as complete ranges of the currently unrestricted displayed routes.
question_results.hidden_comparison: The hidden source_solution and a rationale assume a single straight internal chord with30-degree normal angles, giving0<n<2n_a and an unattained supremum2n_a. This matches the frozen direct-route baseline conditionally, but the missing learner-facing restriction prevents unconditional key agreement. Hidden proof does not rescue the visible question.
question_results.ZHEN_evidence: Both locales equivalently state n, n_a, arbitrary ambient, nongrazing crossings, each option and the hidden straight-chord derivation. Their scientific domain defect is shared, not a translation mismatch.
question_results.production_loss: Range-statement recognition loses geometry construction and written endpoint proof. The unexpressed direct/no-reflection route condition currently destroys the intended unique bound task and must be repaired.
